Name: Cinderbox - Play Desktop SDV on Android
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
[color=#6aa84f][b][size=6]Cinderbox[/size][/b][/color]

We've built a launcher that lets you run the official desktop version of Stardew Valley on your Android device natively! Zero emulation, no translation layers. The latest SMAPI version and Harmony have also been reworked, with >99% of mods reported as compatible.

[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Installation Guide[/size][/b][/color]

1. Compress your Stardew Valley folder to a zip file. To find your SDV folder in Steam: go to Library > Right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files.

2. Download, extract, and install the APK from the zip file.

3. Launch the app to begin the setup flow. It will ask you for your zipped file and extract the contents to the correct folder.

4. After game extraction, you can download the latest SMAPI for Cinderbox directly in the app or from the GitHub page: [url=https://github.com/Ekyso/SMAPI-For-Cinderbox]https://github.com/Ekyso/SMAPI-For-Cinderbox[/url]

[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Additional Info[/size][/b][/color]

- No game files are provided in the APK. It will not run by itself
- Third party licenses can be found [url=https://github.com/Ekyso/Cinderbox/blob/main/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt]here[/url]
- Source code will be available in the [url=https://github.com/Ekyso/Cinderbox]official Github repo
[/url]- Answers to commonly asked questions can be found in our [url=https://github.com/Ekyso/Cinderbox/wiki]wiki[/url]

[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Support[/size]
[/b][/color]
For quick support, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/cinderbox-1464708507923124264]Cinderbox Discord server[/url]. If a mod does not work on Cinderbox, please come to us first. Do not harass mod authors or members of the Official SDV server.
